## History

Elizabeth Kirk, referred to as Mrs. Clow, was present during a church service when [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) fainted from fasting. After Doctor [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) revived [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), [Elizabeth](../character/elizabeth.md) heard [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) explain to her father and [Elizabeth](../character/elizabeth.md) that the Meredith children were raising themselves.
